citations.quote: With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2. Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

children.distinction: The submission channel and listed methods are stated, but the operational relationship between the e-Cert and XML/PDF submission is unspecified; a complete Boolean compliance formalization would require an unsupported satisfaction predicate.
questions: What operational relationship between a Hongkong Post e-Cert and an XML or PDF submission satisfies footnote 3, and what evidence establishes that relationship for this event?
Do the applicable technical requirements impose certificate-holder, authorization or validity conditions, and if so, what are they?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] The proposed question is whether one in-scope post-launch STR submission satisfies the STREAMS 2 channel, one listed submission method, and the footnote 3 e-Cert requirement where XML or PDF was used. A compliance verdict remains unresolved until the certificate relationship and any applicable operational conditions are established.
children.subject: Submission-specific e-Cert requirement without substituting availability or an undefined satisfaction predicate
